Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that's all from this match and series. Afghanistan will now take part in a 3-match ODI series against West Indies, first of which will be played on 9th June in St Lucia at 1430 local (1830 GMT). Do join us for all the action. Cheers!

Asghar Stanikzai admits that they didn't perform well in the first two games but showed improvement today and he hopes to carry the positives in the ODI series. Feels that more they play the top teams, better they will get. He is hopeful of doing good in the ODIs.

Carlos Brathwaite says that they didn't bowl really well and went away from the plans. Considers it a clinical performance with the bat and praises Marlon Samuels for his knock. Admits that Afghanistan played a lot better today and praised them for their progress. Feels that 3-0 against any team is big.

Player of the Match and Series, Marlon Samuels says that he just played the role that was given to him. Adds that the plan was to build partnerships once a wicket falls and steady the ship. Feels that as a senior player his role is to guide the youngsters with his experience. Informs that he always tells the junior batsmen to rotate the strike. Also says that there are a lot of young players in the side and once they settle in they all can play shots.

Afghanistan initiated well with the ball but then failed to maintain the same intensity. They looked clueless against the power hitting of Marlon Samuels and almost surrendered towards the end. Rashid Khan once again was economical but failed to provide more than one breakthrough which was the need of the hour. This ends a very disappointing T20I series for the Afghans in which they got beaten quite comprehensively.

Clean sweep! Mission accomplished for West Indies. After a couple of easy wins, it was a good workout for them. Chasing a challenging target, the hosts slipped a bit up front but Marlon Samuels stood like a rock at one end. He did the bulk of the scoring and threaded a couple of vital partnerships with Evin Lewis and Jason Mohammed respectively to seal the deal.
Full and angling into the batsman, Samuels tucks it off his pads wide of short fine leg for a single. WEST INDIES WIN BY 7 WICKETS!
Back of a length ball angling into the batsman, Mohammed gets back and taps it down to backward point for a quick single. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end. Scores levelled!
Shapoor Zadran to bowl...
Gets down on one knee and sweeps it through square leg for a single. 2 needed off the last over.
Shortish on middle, pulled down to long on for one.
Flatter through the air, on middle, Mohammed gets back and works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Short and on middle, pulled over mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. No run.
Flatter on middle, dragged over mid-wicket for one.

Great delivery, finding the blockhole, Samuels tries digging it out but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls to the off side and they cross. This is now Samuels' highest individual score in T20Is!
SIX! Into the night sky! Good length ball angling into the batsman, on middle and leg, Samuels swings his big arms across the line and deposits it over mid-wicket for a maximum. No holds barred!
50-run stand between Marlon Samuels and Jason Mohammed.
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.
SIX! Great shot! Into the darker side of the ground it goes. Full and wide outside off, Mohammed latches onto it and rockets it over covers for a biggie.
Identical to the last delivery, this time it's eased away down to long on for one.
Full and around off, defended from the crease.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads.

Flatter on off, Samuels taps it down to short third man and Jason Mohammed comes running down the track for a run. Marlon ain't interested but as soon as Shapoor Zadran misfields, they cross. Really, Sha-POOR!
Fullish on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Short delivery, slapped to sweeper cover for a single.
Turns it off his pads to square leg for a single.
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.
Goes down to slog sweep but mistimes it towards long on for one.
Very full on middle, bunted down to long on for one.
Marlon Samuels has completely snatched the momentum away from Afghanistan and West Indies are now in the driver's seat.

APPEAL FOR A RUN OUT! Fuller and on off, Samuels forces it right back and it gets deflected from Mohammed's bat to covers. Jason wants a run but is sent back. The throw comes to the bowler who takes the bails off and appeals. It's referred upstairs and the replays find Jason Mohammed safe.
SIX! Take that! Samuels is in killer mood. Nabi serves it flatter and around off, Samuels clears his front leg and smokes it over mid-wicket for another biggie.
SIX! Short and down the leg side, that's a real gift, Marlon dispatches it with utter disdain into the stand at fine leg.

Starts this spell from around the wicket and puts it on a fuller length on middle, Samuels drills it down the ground and the long off fielder running across to his right in the deep fumbles. Luckily the long on fielder backs it behind and saves two runs.
Mohammad Nabi is back on.

EDGY FOUR! Maybe, that's why Shapoor wasn't pitching it full. Because when he does so, and drops it in the line of the stumps, the batsman swings and gets it away off the inside edge to the boundary at fine leg. But can that be the excuse for bowling short? Don't think so.
Poor, extremely poor bowling. Keeps his length short and around off, Samuels pulls it firmly down to long on for a single.
Short again, angling into the right-hander from around the wicket, Mohammed pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Poor length and punished. Samuels stays put to a short ball outside off and clobbers it via a pull shot to the deep mid-wicket fence. This is some ferocious hitting.
Shapoor Zadran steams in from around the wicket and spears in a full ball on off, Samuels uses the angle and tickles it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Shapoor Zadran comes on to bowl.
Knocks it down to long on for a run. 56 needed off 36 balls.
10th T20I 50 up for Marlon Samuels!

FOUR! Fine shot! A short ball at a gentle pace on middle, Samuels gets deep inside the crease and dismisses it with a powerful pull shot to the deep mid-wicket fence. Rashid Khan in the deep attacks the ball and misfields. Brings up Samuels' half century and raises his bat. Needs to stay till the end!
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.

Chance of a run out! Fuller in length and following the batsman down the leg side, Samuels fails to keep it out and it goes off his pads towards the leg side. The non-striker wants a run and comes running in half-way down the track but is sent back. The keeper gets to the ball, fires in a throw but it's off target at the bowler's end.
Fuller and angling into the batsman, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Karim Janat is brought back into the attack.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Jason Mohammed comes out to bat.

OUT! Simmons holes out! Afghanistan are doing a good job by picking wickets at regular intervals. Rashid Khan once again bowls it outside off, fuller in length and offering width, Simmons tries emulating the last shot but this time he has hit it straight and into the hands of Najibullah Zadran at long off. One can sense a hint of tension in the air, 65 needed off 43 balls.
SIX! Just over the rope! Full flighted delivery outside off, plenty of room for the batsman, Simmons attacks it and smacks it over extra cover for a maximum.
Samuels as played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Pulls his length back and serves it around off, Samuels tries to play a late dab but misses.
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run.
Walks down the track, takes himself away from the line of the stumps and then pads it away. 9 from the over!
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Dropped! Flatter ball on off, straightening a bit, Simmons gets forward to defend but edges it behind. The keeper is late in reacting and it brushes his gloves before rolling down to short third man. A single taken.
FOUR! Poor delivery, short and on off, spinning away, Simmons goes deep inside the crease and blazes his square cut to the fence. Cracking shot.
Shortish and on off, Samuels hangs back and punches it down the ground. Goes on one bounce to the long off fielder and they take a single.
Bowls it from wide of the crease and fires it in, Samuels punches it to long off for a single. The throw comes to the bowler who fails to collect and they cross for an overthrow as well.
Amir Hamza is back on.
A leg spinner, landing on off and spinning away a shade, Simmons pushes inside the line and misses.
In the air... safe! Flatter and quicker on middle, Simmons chips it over mid-wicket and it falls wide of the fielder in the deep. A couple taken.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
Drops it shortish on off, Samuels punches it to sweeper cover for one.

Flatter ball, on the pads, played out towards short mid-wicket and the batsman stepped out looking for a run. But he returned because Rashid attacked the ball to his right and sent a sharp throw to the keeper immediately. A lot of energy whenever Rashid is in the frame.
Flighted full ball on middle, forced down to long on for a run.
Rashid Khan comes into the attack.
Short ball, Simmons plays it to the point region for a run.
Lendl Simmons is in next. 86 needed off 61 balls.

OUT! The bowling change works. Nabi gets the breakthrough for Afghanistan. He fires it in on the stumps, Lewis goes back and tries to work it across the line but misses it and gets struck on the pads. They all appeal and the umpire after taking his time gives it out. Can Afghanistan build on this wicket?
Knocks a full ball down through mid off for one.

DROPPED BY NABI! You need to take those catches at this level. Samuels gets a reprieve. Flatter delivery, shortish and in the line of the stumps, Samuels hangs back and smashes it back uppishly. Nabi reacts but fails to hold on to the catch. Poor work.
Quicker one, fired into the batsman, it's punched back to the bowler.
FOUR! Poor delivery first up, short and on leg stump, Samuels uses the crease well, goes deep inside it and hammer-pulls it behind square leg for a boundary.
Mohammad Nabi is brought back into the attack.
Skidding back into the batsman, punched from the crease to covers.
Shout for an lbw! Quicker one around leg, Lewis fails to sweep and it brushes his pads. The bowler appeals but nothing from the umpire.
Fires it in on middle, helped to mid-wicket for a run.
Turns it with the spin on the leg side, finds the gap at mid-wicket for one.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. One run added to the total.
50-run partnership between Evin Lewis and Marlon Samuels.

FOUR! Boom! Quicker, flatter and shorter on off, Samuels rocks back and bludgeons it through the legs of the bowler for a boundary. Hamza hardly got any chance to bring his hands down, in fact, it's good that he was late into it, otherwise he would have hurt his fingers badly. Rocketed away to the fence.
Short outside off, Samuels pulls it to long on for a run.
Full on middle, Lewis heaves it long on for a run.
FOUR! EASY PICKINGS! Full ball on the pads, Lewis just lofts it over mid-wicket for a boundary. A much-needed boundary for West Indies.
Good length outside off, Lewis guides it to point.
Shorter in length outside off, Samuels wants to pull it through mid-wicket but gets it off the splice of the bat towards mid off. They run through for a single.
Very full on leg stump, Lewis drives it down to long on for a run.
Shorter outside off, Samuels cuts it to point.
Shorter outside off, Lewis cuts it to point for a run.
Fires it into the pads, Lewis sweeps it to the fielder.
Short and spinning away, Samuels goes back and punches it towards covers where Rashid stops it with his right hand. A single taken.
Darts it on the stumps, Samuels defends it from within the crease.
Drags back his length outside off, Lewis punches it down to long on for a run.
Bowled on the pads, Lewis flicks it to the leg side for a run.
Tad short, Samuels gets it to long on for a single.
Back of a length ball, Lewis pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
Length ball on off stump, Lewis pushes it to cover off the back foot.
SIX! GREAT SHOT! Slightly short on the pads. Lewis rocks back and pulls it over the fine leg fence for a maximum. Easy pickings for Lewis. First maximum for him.
Length ball on the stumps, Samuels moves his front leg out of the way and drives it past cover-point for a run.
Karim Janat comes on to bowl.
Darts it in on middle, Evin punches it down to mid off. The fielder rushes to the ball and hence no run taken. Good start for Hamza, only 5 from it!
Forces a full ball down to long on for one.
FOUR! Doesn't miss out  this time. Flatter and shorter outside off, Samuels packs a punch and this time finds the gap at backward point for a boundary.
Floated and full on off, driven to covers. Again straight to the fielder.
Flatter and shorter again, hit straight to the point fielder again.
Shortish and outside off, cut straight to point.
Amir Hamza comes into the attack.
Samuels drives the ball on the stumps to long on for a run.
FOUR! SMASHED! Bowled on the stumps, Samuels thumps it down the ground for another boundary. Back-to-back boundaries in the over. Good start for the Windies.
FOUR! LOVELY SHOT! Bowls it outside off, Samuels drives it through mid off past the diving fielder. Samuels looks to be in good touch.
Quicker one outside off, Samuels goes for an expansive drive but gets an edge just short of the diving short third man fielder.
Flatter ball on the stumps, punched off the back foot to mid off.
Bowled on the stumps, Samuels drives it back to the bowler.
Full ball on off, Samuels drives it wide of mid off for a run.
, Slightly back of a length, opens up the batsman and Samuels gets beaten as he opens the face of his bat.
Full ball outside off, Samuels drives it to mid off.
FOUR! Bowls a full slower ball on the stumps, Samuels moves his front leg out of the way and hits it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Bowled on his pads, Lewis flicks it on the leg side for a run.
Good length ball on off, rushes the batsman with pace, Lewis tries to flick and gets hit on the back thigh.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, Lewis goes for a flick but misses it and the umpire signals a wide.
Slides it onto the pads, Lewis plays it to mid-wicket for a run.
Short outside off, Lewis cuts it to point.
Driven towards the mid off region.
Bowled on the stumps, Lewis drives it to mid on.
Drags the length back, Samuels pushes it off the back foot uppishly through mid-wicket. The fielder dives but it just falls short of him. He gets a hand on it and concedes a single.
Shortish on off, punched to mid off.
Mohammad Nabi comes on to bowl.
Length ball outside off, Samuels tries to punch but gets an outside edge to third man for a run.
Bowls it on the pads, Samuels flicks it on the leg side for no run.
Full length ball outside off, Samuels tries to guide it down to third man but misses it.
FOUR! Just wide of the keeper! Full ball on off, Samuels opens the face of the bat and guides it past the diving keeper down to the third man fence for a boundary.
Marlon Samuels strides out to the middle.

OUT! What a start here for Afghanistan! They have got an early wicket. Full ball outside off, Walton drives it uppishly to Samiullah Shenwari (sub) at short cover who takes a good low catch. West Indies lose their first wicket and it is Walton, the man in form.
Noor Ali Zadran has taken an awkward blow on his right ankle. He is leaving the field. Samiullah Shenwari is the substitute fielder.
Starts off with a low full toss, Walton drives it down to mid off where Noor Ali Zadran stops the ball and seems to have hurt himself in the process.
Back for the run chase. Chadwick Walton and Evin Lewis are the West Indian openers. Shapoor Zadran to steam in first up...
